answer: Yes, we buy cars registered in any state we serve even if you now live in a different one, so bring your Virginia registration. At a North Carolina store, the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew your expired Virginia registration before your appointment. A car registered in another state also needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it at a North Carolina store. Because the plates are Virginia plates, you'll remove them and keep them.
